scope: Final source and claim reconciliation against the supplied local paper, pinned official files and primary Qwen3 sources already retained in attention-architecture.json. This record is a manual editorial audit, not an additional numerical test or model reproduction.

checks.reviewed_conclusion: Polar factor uses the nonzero subspace; zero singular directions are not completed into nonzero directions. The spectral-norm minimizer is described as one optimal direction.

checks.evidence: Paper p.3 and pinned polynomial helper
checks.reviewed_conclusion: The five-step Muon polynomial is distinguished from its ideal polar target; f(1)=0.701 for the stated coefficients and finite outputs need not be exactly one.
Entropy normalizes singular amplitudes, not their squares; dimensions and gradient-versus-momentum scope remain explicit. Zero entropy terms and all-zero convention are stated.
Action-only 4500-step comparison is not merged with all-module 1500-step comparison. The reported exact-SVD baseline runtime is not a universal low-rank-optimizer cost.
SNR is squared mean over gradient variance, not a norm or one singular value. Repeated sampling requires a fixed checkpoint and specified averaging.

Nondegenerate-group probability is conditional on independent equal-success-probability responses. Representative lengths, score variance/independence, importance-ratio factorization and clipping-mask approximations remain explicit. Zero reward advantage does not imply zero KL-loss gradient.
Matrix/scalar polynomial factorization and fixed singular subspaces are exact-arithmetic identities; BF16 results are separately observed, including small off-subspace components.
Endpoint constraints reduce to a one-parameter family; derivative endpoint conditions yield c in [-1.5,0.375]. Maximal origin slope gives Promotion; zero origin slope uniquely gives Suppression.
Suppression fixed point sqrt(2/3) is distinct from full five-step 0.5-response inputs. Promotion-minus-Suppression is nonnegative on [0,1], and five promotions omit suppression entirely.

checks.evidence: Constructed spectra and independent Decimal/SVD records
checks.reviewed_conclusion: Four-direction responses preserve original input labels; output order can differ for finite Muon. A flat spectrum can retain relative effective rank while all updates become tiny. Fixed clean-signal examples do not identify real gradient noise.

checks.evidence: Paper AppendixG p.26 versus primary Qwen3 report/implementation
checks.reviewed_conclusion: The appendix assumes standard attention. Qwen3 applies post-projection QK-Norm; weight-norm temperature intuition alone cannot explain its actual attention. Per-head filtering does not promise norm-ratio preservation.
Query/KV heads are16/8 for1.7B and32/8 for4B. Explicit head_dim128 gives Q4096x2560, K/V1024x2560, O2560x4096. Q/K/V split output rows, O splits input columns.

checks.evidence: Paper TableA1, TableA3, TableA5 and TableA6
checks.reviewed_conclusion: VLA main Pion configuration is a mixed assignment; modality and per-head ablations retain their own scopes. TableA6 AdamW43.6 versus main32.2 at1500steps remains a reported discrepancy, without invented reconciliation.

Transcribed success rates, suite means and percentage-point differences agree. Robot rounding corresponds to28+25+24 successes in90 trials; trials are not independent training seeds or arbitrary-task success guarantees.

Eight algorithm/model/dataset settings are distinguished. MATH/GSM8K prompt batches128/1024, rollouts8/5, token limits1024/3000 and512/1024, and steps80/40 match the paper. No graph-derived precise final accuracy or seed errors are invented.

checks.evidence: Pinned VLA/RL/openpi classes and launch configurations
checks.reviewed_conclusion: Class default scale factors0.2/5.0/2.0 can be overridden. GSM8K scripts use15epochs andKL loss; VLANeXt default6000steps differs from paper4000/10000. Actual run budgets must be explicit.

checks.evidence: Pinned RL update ordering and independent multi-step probes
checks.reviewed_conclusion: EMA, Nesterov, decoupled weight decay and shape multiplier are separate from the scalar polynomial. Zero and missing gradients have distinct state behavior. Gradient-only RMS excludes decay and uses a stable scaled norm.

checks.evidence: Pinned VLA loop, replay/Gloo and unmodified CUDA/NCCL probe
checks.reviewed_conclusion: The receive buffer is cleared before prior gather consumption. CPU adaptations and actual one-rank CUDA observations are distinguished;64cases contain56normalcontrols and8observed mismatches, not64healthyupdates.

checks.evidence: Pinned VLA gradient mixing/normalization helper and direct mutation probe
checks.reviewed_conclusion: Raw gradients should be recorded before optimizer mutation, after required synchronization/unscaling. Local shards and logical full matrices must be distinguished.

checks.evidence: Paper AppendixM p.43 and pinned optimizer state
checks.reviewed_conclusion: LLM-pretraining underperformance is the authors prediction/future-work limit, not a reported score. Low-rank spectral updates do not imply sparse arrays or compressed momentum storage.
